no-style-color.description: No color or backgroundColor in style= props

no-raw-css-color.description: No raw color values in component CSS. Use semantic tokens instead

no-var-color.description: No CSS variable behind a color class. Use the token's semantic utility class instead

no-opacity-modifier.description: No opacity modifiers on color classes. Add a semantic token instead

no-spectral-color.description: No spectral (palette) Tailwind color classes. Use semantic tokens instead

no-dark-variant.description: Don't use dark: variant. Use semantic tokens instead

no-useless-hover.description: Don't use hover: on non-interactive elements

no-component-color-override.description: Don't override color className on component. Choose from the variants, or create a new one

no-undefined-token.description: Color class references a token not defined in the color token files
